reason: The earlier compact-profile gains (0.4714 degree-matched, 0.8768 fair) were produced with held-out target-disease edges still present in message passing. Removing held-out edges from the message graph gives much lower but honest scores, and the compact profile's advantage shrinks to +0.005/+0.008 degree-matched and +0.013/+0.014 fair.
